stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The dry reservoir created a serious water deficit.
items.sentenceZh: 水库干涸造成了严重缺水。
items.scene: A reservoir shows a broad exposed shoreline and one remaining shallow pool while town workers deliver water tanks and residents conserve small amounts, making the deficit visible without charts.
items.altText: 干涸水库造成严重用水短缺

items.sentenceEn: The renovated bathroom is accessible to every resident.
items.sentenceZh: 改造后的浴室方便每位住户使用。
items.scene: A bright renovated bathroom includes a roll-in shower, secure grab bars, nonslip floor, lowered sink, and turning space as a wheelchair user checks the practical layout.
items.altText: 无障碍浴室方便所有住户使用

items.meaningZh: 目的；目标；宗旨；宾格；实物
items.sentenceEn: The team's objective was to restore the wetland.
items.sentenceZh: 团队的目标是恢复湿地。
items.scene: A conservation team removes invasive plants and replants reeds around one damaged pond while healthy birds return to the restored side, making the shared objective clear without signs.
items.altText: 保护团队以恢复湿地为共同目标

items.sentenceEn: An electronic sensor opened the greenhouse vents automatically.
items.sentenceZh: 电子传感器自动打开温室通风窗。
items.scene: Inside a warm greenhouse, a small unbranded electronic sensor triggers roof vents to open as the air heats up, while a gardener observes the plants and blank control panel.
items.altText: 电子传感器自动开启温室通风窗

items.sentenceEn: The architect became an ally for accessible design.
items.sentenceZh: 这位建筑师成为无障碍设计的支持者。
items.scene: An architect stands beside wheelchair users and older residents at a building model, listening and revising the entrance ramp as a practical ally rather than speaking over them.
items.altText: 建筑师支持并推动无障碍设计

items.styleFamily: historical Chinese Silk Road gouache illustration
items.sentenceEn: The long journey carried silk across the desert.
items.sentenceZh: 漫长旅程把丝绸运过沙漠。
items.scene: A historically inspired Silk Road caravan travels from a green oasis into broad desert dunes, with pack camels carrying wrapped silk and travelers following a distant mountain pass.
items.altText: 丝路商队踏上穿越沙漠的漫长旅程

items.sentenceEn: Years of honest work built the tea master's reputation.
items.sentenceZh: 多年的诚信经营建立了茶师的声誉。
items.scene: In an old Chinese tea shop, customers return with trust as an experienced tea master carefully weighs leaves, helps an apprentice, and refuses a flawed batch, showing earned reputation.
items.altText: 茶师以多年诚信工作赢得声誉

items.sentenceEn: The herbalist stirred the fragrant mixture in a clay bowl.
items.sentenceZh: 药材师在陶碗里搅拌芳香混合物。
items.scene: In a traditional Chinese herbal workshop, a trained herbalist combines several clearly distinct dried plants into one clay bowl and stirs the mixture with a wooden tool, no labels.
items.altText: 药材师在陶碗中调和草本混合物

items.sentenceEn: With dark clouds overhead, rain would surely arrive soon.
items.sentenceZh: 乌云压顶，雨肯定很快就会来。
items.scene: Farmers look toward dense rain clouds advancing across a dry field as the first nearby drops darken the dust and they confidently uncover empty water barrels.
items.altText: 乌云和初雨表明降雨肯定到来

items.sentenceEn: The ancient tower rose above the riverside town.
items.sentenceZh: 古塔高耸在河畔城镇上方。
items.scene: A many-tiered Chinese pagoda tower rises far above tiled riverside houses at sunset, with boats and tiny pedestrians establishing its height and reflection stretching across calm water.
items.altText: 古老中式塔楼高耸在河畔城镇上方

items.sentenceEn: Smoke from the toaster triggered the kitchen alarm.
items.sentenceZh: 烤面包机的烟触发了厨房警报器。
items.scene: A small stream of harmless burnt-toast smoke rises toward a ceiling alarm while a cook unplugs the toaster, opens the window, and checks the empty kitchen safely.
items.altText: 烤面包产生的烟触发厨房警报

items.meaningZh: 使面对；对抗；遭遇；使对质；比较
items.sentenceEn: Residents confront the factory owner with evidence of pollution.
items.sentenceZh: 居民拿着污染证据与工厂主当面对质。
items.scene: At a calm public meeting, residents place jars of discolored river water before a factory owner, who faces the evidence and listens while an environmental mediator keeps discussion constructive.
items.altText: 居民用污染证据与工厂负责人对质

items.meaningZh: 纯的；纯净的；纯洁的；清白的；完美的
items.sentenceEn: Pure spring water flowed from the mountain rock.
items.sentenceZh: 纯净泉水从山岩中流出。
items.scene: Crystal-clear spring water emerges directly from mossy rock in a Chinese mountain forest, revealing every pale pebble beneath while a hiker fills a plain metal cup downstream.
items.altText: 纯净山泉从苔藓岩石间流出

items.sentenceEn: She took a quick glance at the clock before leaving.
items.sentenceZh: 她离开前迅速瞥了一眼时钟。
items.scene: At a busy doorway, a woman already holding her coat and bag turns her eyes briefly toward a wall clock while her body continues toward the open door, capturing a quick glance.
items.altText: 女子出门前快速瞥一眼墙上时钟

items.sentenceEn: The carpenter checked every dimension of the wooden frame.
items.sentenceZh: 木匠检查了木框的每个尺寸。
items.scene: A carpenter uses a square, ruler, and calipers to check the height, width, and depth of a wooden frame from several angles, with all measurement marks unreadable.
items.altText: 木匠检查木框各个方向的尺寸

items.meaningZh: 玩具；小玩艺儿；小型的东西；消遣
items.sentenceEn: The wooden toy moved when the child turned its handle.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子转动手柄时，木制玩具动了起来。
items.scene: A child and adult craftsperson test a handmade wooden bird toy whose wings rise as a side handle turns, with visible simple gears and complete hands, no glossy plastic.
items.altText: 转动手柄让木制鸟玩具活动

items.sentenceEn: The prisoner met privately with a legal adviser.
items.sentenceZh: 这名囚犯与法律顾问私下会面。
items.scene: In a clean supervised consultation room, an adult prisoner in plain clothing sits across from a legal adviser reviewing blank papers, with respectful eye contact and no restraints or humiliation.
items.altText: 囚犯在咨询室与法律顾问会面

items.sentenceEn: A fellow researcher helped her carry the samples.
items.sentenceZh: 一位研究同事帮她搬运样本。
items.scene: On a muddy field station path, one researcher notices a colleague struggling with sample cases and takes half the load while they continue together toward the laboratory.
items.altText: 研究同事主动帮助搬运样本

items.sentenceEn: The weaver inspected the smooth surface of the silk.
items.sentenceZh: 织工检查丝绸光滑的表面。
items.scene: In a Suzhou silk workshop, a weaver runs complete fingertips lightly over a finished length of luminous silk, contrasting its smooth surface with rough raw cocoons nearby.
items.altText: 苏州织工检查丝绸光滑表面

items.sentenceEn: A nearby clinic treated the injured cyclist quickly.
items.sentenceZh: 附近的诊所迅速救治了受伤骑手。
items.scene: After a minor bicycle fall, companions guide a conscious cyclist only a short distance across the square to a visible neighborhood clinic where a nurse waits at the doorway.
items.altText: 附近诊所迅速帮助轻伤骑手
